description: This file declares utility functions, structures, and constants for testing the SbPlayer component in the starboard namespace, including configuration structures, test file retrieval functions, dummy callback functions, and creation/writing functions for SbPlayer objects.

classes.name: SbPlayerTestConfig
classes.description: Structure holding configuration parameters for SbPlayer tests, including filenames, output mode, key system, and maximum video capabilities.

methods.name: GetAudioTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of audio test filenames.

methods.name: GetVideoTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of video test filenames.

methods.name: GetPlayerOutputModes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported SbPlayer output modes.

methods.name: GetKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of key system strings.

methods.name: GetSupportedSbPlayerTestConfigs
methods.description: Returns a list of supported SbPlayer test configurations, optionally filtered by key system.

methods.name: GetSbPlayerTestConfigName
methods.description: Generates a string name for a given SbPlayerTestConfig.

methods.name: DummyDecoderStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for decoder status callback.

methods.name: DummyPlayerStatusFunc
methods.description: Dummy function for player status callback.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerCreate
methods.description: Creates an SbPlayer with specified parameters.

methods.name: CallSbPlayerWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes samples to the SbPlayer from a VideoDmpReader.

methods.name: IsOutputModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific output mode is supported for given codecs and key system.

methods.name: IsPartialAudioSupported
methods.description: Checks if partial audio is supported.

methods.name: IsAudioPassthroughUsed
methods.description: Determines if audio passthrough is used based on the test configuration.
